authority_basis.summary: Continue deriving or falsifying the Mellin-dilation Xi quotient and add own research to the ledger with claimed sequence numbers.

operations.title: Entry 1400 — Finite-Place Scaling Colimits Cannot Acquire the Xi Spectrum
operations.summary: Finite-place CCM scaling operators are all unitarily equivalent to the same absolutely-continuous multiplication operator; the raw critical-line Euler product also diverges at the central point. A nonunitary quotient or boundary is necessary.

operations.title: The naive semilocal scaling colimit cannot acquire discrete Xi spectrum
operations.statement: For finite S the CCM density is positive and equivalent to Lebesgue measure, so its scaling operator is unitarily equivalent to M_s on L2(R), with purely absolutely continuous spectrum and noncompact resolvent. Canonical place-enlargement identifications do not alter that spectral type. Moreover the unrenormalized finite Euler multiplier diverges at s=0 as S exhausts the primes.
operations.scope: No-go for the ambient canonical colimit and raw Euler multiplier; conditioned, radical, or renormalized quotients remain open.

operations.title: Central-value and spectral-type colimit falsifier
operations.description: At every finite S, conjugate by the positive square-root of the density to Lebesgue M_s. Separately evaluate the partial Euler product at s=0 and bound its logarithm below by the divergent sum of reciprocal primes.
